nodes.rationale: TanStack Start derives routes from .tsx files in src/routes. Next.js / Remix conventions (src/pages/, app/layout.tsx, src/routes/_app/index.tsx) are explicitly forbidden; __root.tsx is the only root layout and routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated and must not be hand-edited.
